categories.main_business_segments: JNBY Group operates primarily in the designer fashion industry, focusing on the design, promotion, and sale of contemporary apparel, footwear, accessories, and household products. Its brand portfolio is segmented into Mature (JNBY), Younger (CROQUIS, jnby by JNBY, LESS), and Emerging brands (POMME DE TERRE, JNBYHOME, onmygame, B1OCK), each targeting distinct customer segments and lifestyle needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes forward-looking design and research and development capabilities, integrating internet thinking and technology to enhance its omni-channel retail network and intelligent quick response supply chain. It invests in digital R&D, intelligent warehousing, and supply chain optimization to support product innovation and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JNBY targets middle- and upper-income customers who seek to express individuality through fashion, covering a broad age range from children to urban professionals. The customer base includes children, modern women, men, and urban elites with interests in art, avant-garde fashion, and sustainable lifestyles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across Mainland China, covering all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities, with additional presence in Hong Kong, Taiwan, and ten other countries and regions globally. Its retail network includes over 2,100 standalone stores worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: JNBY operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on design, production, marketing, and retailing of fashion products through self-operated and distributor-operated stores as well as online channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic priorities include dual-driven growth through design and brand power, multi-brand scale development, and building a fan economy. It focuses on enhancing brand strength, expanding omni-channel retail networks, leveraging data and technology, and promoting sustainability and ESG practices. R&D efforts emphasize innovative design, sustainable fashion, and digital retail capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales to distributors and direct sales to end customers via self-operated physical stores, distributor-operated stores, and online platforms. The company also operates multi-brand collection stores providing value-added services to consumers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JNBY is positioned as an influential designer brand fashion group in China with a diversified brand portfolio catering to various market segments. It competes in a segmented market with increasing competition among leading designer brands, focusing on product quality, brand image, and innovative retail experiences to maintain market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, JNBY reported revenue of RMB5.55 billion, a 4.6% increase from the previous year, and net profit of RMB898 million, up 6.0%. The Group operates over 2,100 retail stores globally and maintains a strong cash flow position, with steady growth in online sales and a loyal customer base exceeding 560,000 active members.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JNBY emphasizes unique design identities under the philosophy 'Just Naturally Be Yourself,' offering contemporary, high-quality, and sustainable fashion products that cater to diverse lifestyle needs. The Group differentiates itself through innovative design, multi-brand lifestyle ecosystems, omni-channel retail integration, and a strong fan economy that fosters customer loyalty and personalized shopping experiences.
